units.source_text: 待看时，楼里面便正如所闻，胡乱的抛着几个死尸，但是火光所到的范围，却比预想的尤其狭，辨不出那些的数目来。

en.t: When he looked, the inside of the tower was just as he had heard: several corpses lay scattered about at random. But the reach of the firelight was far narrower than he had expected, and he could not make out how many there were.

units.source_text: 只在朦胧中，知道是有赤体的死尸和穿衣服的死尸；又自然是男的女的也都有。

en.t: In the dimness, he could only tell that there were naked corpses and corpses wearing clothes; naturally, there were both men and women.

units.source_text: 而且那些死尸，或者张着嘴或者伸着手，

en.t: And those corpses, some with mouths hanging open and some with arms stretched out,

units.source_text: 纵横在楼板上的情形，几乎令人要疑心到他也曾为人的事实。

en.t: lay strewn every which way across the floorboards, in a state that almost made one doubt they had ever been human.

units.source_text: 加之只是肩膀胸脯之类的高起的部分，受着淡淡的光，

en.t: Moreover, only the raised parts, such as shoulders and chests, caught the faint light,

units.source_text: 而低下的部分的影子却更加暗黑，哑似的永久的默着。

en.t: while the shadows in the lower parts were even darker and blacker, silently mute as though they would remain so forever.
